notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
- Updated to newest Steam VR SDK.
- You can select a stage level that you've been played before. No more pain!
- Music and SoundFX volume control is available.
- Minor bug fixes.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
A few simple issues has been updated.

- BGM volume reduced.
- If you select Retry, you can continue at the failed stage.

And thanks to everyone who played our game!
